claims.claim_text: The residence is subject to an active domestic violence restraining order prohibiting a former partner from approaching within 50 yards.
The subject responded that he was visiting a friend and that she had invited him over.
Officer Pruitt arrived on scene approximately four minutes after I made initial contact with the subject.
The subject paused momentarily and faced me, then turned and entered the enclosed patio area. At that point, I warned the subject I would deploy my Taser.
I deployed my Taser, striking the subject in the upper back. The subject fell forward onto his stomach on the patio floor.
Immediately after the Taser deployment, Officer Pruitt advanced to the patio threshold.
The subject rolled from his stomach to his back, reached toward his left hip, and produced a black handgun.
Officer Pruitt, fearing for my safety, discharged his firearm, firing seven rounds. I simultaneously transitioned from my Taser to my duty weapon and discharged nine rounds.
During this time, the subject was heard to say, "Just let me die."
The subject's movements near the weapon continued intermittently for approximately three minutes before additional units arrived.
Officer Holt arrived at approximately 2143 hours and secured the handgun.
OCFA Engine 84 arrived at approximately 2148 hours and transported the subject to UCI Medical Center.
I was dispatched to the location and arrived at approximately 2140 hours, ahead of Officer Pruitt.
The subject was pronounced deceased at approximately 2232 hours.
